text:
deploy-bot: Planned DB change '2026_05_events_add_source' scheduled for 03:30-04:15 UTC. Runtime pinned: r12.4. This is a low-impact add-column + streaming backfill. Canary on 1% for 15m. Auto-pause on replication lag >3s or error_rate >2.
leo: quick context: adding `source VARCHAR(32)` to events table. We'll use `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` without default then stream-populate to avoid table rewrite. Backfill job: `stream_backfill --concurrency=8 --batch=1000`.
sam: confirm no default so it won't rewrite table?
leo: yep — step 1: ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN source VARCHAR(32);
step 2: run streaming iterator to fill values using event payload heuristics; step 3: optional index add after backfill.
rachael: ops concern: this table is write-heavy during peak. Window chosen is low-traffic but still want a hard holdpoint at +20m if p95 writes increase >200ms.
maria: rollback plan: 1) stop backfill; 2) set feature flag `events_source_read` -> false to stop consumers reading it; 3) run a compacting job to revert partially populated rows if needed (manual). Also have a plan to fail open if consumers tolerate nulls.
leo: can we add a preflight that checks replication lag and open transactions count?
sam: deploy-bot can run preflight checks 10m before window and abort if replicas >1s lag or open tx > 5.
deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled at 03:20 UTC. Preflight checks: schema lint, migration dry-run, replica_lag < 1s required.
rachael: add watch on `pg_stat_activity` for long-running transactions >30s during the window. If we see >3, abort and escalate.
maria: also add a temporary Datadog dashboard tile `migration:events_source` showing write p95/p99, replica lag, pg_locks > 10.
leo: request: please pin runtime r12.4 — build 2026-05-09 included a change that reduces snapshot interference.
sam: noted. r12.4 pinned. That will prevent the speculative compile that caused minor pause last month.
opsbot: @maria assigned as approver for window (03:30-04:15 UTC). Pager: primary maria, backup sam.
leo: release notes snippet: "Add new source column to events for enriched attribution. Zero-downtime add; streaming backfill will fill historical rows. Consumers will be behind a feature flag until verified." Link: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2026-05-events-source
maria: put a holdpoint at +15m and +45m. +45m is the final gate before allowing index creation. Both require explicit :thumbsup: from approver.
deploy-bot: Canary check times: 03:45 and 04:05 UTC. Canary will validate sample reads, write latency, and consumer error rates.
sam: I'll monitor consumer errors and write p95. Ping @maria at +14m for the first hold.
rachael: small ops note — if `pg_locks` count spikes, prefer pausing backfill over killing connections. We'll give 60s to settle then abort.
leo: thanks. I'll post a final readiness message 20m before.
deploy-bot: All preflight checks passing: schema-lint ✅, dry-run ✅, runtime-pin r12.4 ✅. Proceed unless a hold requested. Good luck! :party:
